title: Insights
intro: Choose a report and refine the analysis with filters tailored to that subject.
leaveDescription: Usage, balance and distribution of leave types for the selected period.
employeeDescription: Composition and development of the workforce.
employeesDepartmentDescription: Employee count and distribution across departments.
employeesGenderDescription: Employee distribution by gender, with unknown and other kept visible.
employeesAgeDescription: Age profile with age bands and average age.
terminationsDescription: Departures by period, reason, team and segment.
upcoming-eventsDescription: Birthdays, work anniversaries and new starters by period and department.
absenceDescription: Absence rate, reports and duration by organisational unit.
provisionDescription: Financial insight into outstanding leave obligations.
wvpDescription: Progress and points of attention within the Gatekeeper Improvement Act.
visualReadyDescription: Filters, sorting, URL state and visual structure are ready. The verified data source will be connected in a future slice; no sample figures are shown here.
noDataSourceTitle: The data source will follow later
noDataSourceDescription: This report is part of the fixed report catalogue. Once the required source data, authorisation and privacy rules are ready, the analysis will appear here automatically.
exportLater: Export will follow with the validated data source
privacyHint: Aggregated personal data is suppressed for small groups.
noResults: No employees found for this selection.
actualDataTitle: Distribution based on current employee data
exportSuccess: The CSV export was downloaded and is ready for Excel.
exportFailed: The CSV export could not be created. Please try again.
upcomingEventsEmpty: No upcoming events for this selection.
absenceCurrentData: Current absence in the selected period
absenceFormulaHint: The absence rate is scheduled hours missed divided by scheduled available hours × 100. The calculation accounts for schedules, part-time work and partial absence.
absenceBradfordDescription: Combines the frequency and duration of absence spells for the selected period.
absenceBradfordInfoFormula: The Bradford factor is S² × D: S is the number of separate absence spells and D is the total roster-weighted absence days in the selected period.
absenceBradfordInfoInterpretation: The score highlights the disruptive effect of repeated short absences. A higher score calls for a careful conversation, not an automatic action.
absenceBradfordInfoMedium: 51 to 400 — discuss attendance and consider appropriate support.
absenceBradfordInfoHigh: Above 400 — high signal; plan an HR and manager conversation in good time.
absenceBradfordInfoCaveat: Never use this factor as a standalone judgement. Consider legal protection, pregnancy, disability, chronic conditions and agreed exceptions. Do not store medical causes.
absenceFrequentDescription: Employees with the number of sickness reports in the selected period. Frequent absentees are highlighted.
absenceFrequentThresholdDescription: An employee is a frequent absentee with {threshold} or more sickness reports in the selected period. This threshold is configurable via Settings → Absence.
